title: objectstack-formula skill: "Surfaces" says an unevaluable SharingRule condition aborts the write; lint and runtime skip the rule instead
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRY38EZf38Yy3zthbY

Filed as a `finding` by seat `repo:objectstack#2` from the l2-review#4 record 7081992501 on PR #36354 (escalated out of scope; pre-existing). Not triaged; not claimed.

## What

`skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md`, "Surfaces" paragraph (line ~450 at 5dfda7151), says an unevaluable `SharingRule` `condition` "aborts the write".

`packages/lint/src/validate-sharing-rule-enforceability.ts` says otherwise: a condition that does not lower to a filter is a build error, and at runtime the rule is skipped and grants nothing, with one WARN line. Eval case 14 in the same skill (added by #36354) already teaches the skip.

So the published skill tells an author the wrong failure mode for a sharing rule.

## Not measured

This is a static read of the lint header and the skill text. The runtime skip was not reproduced here.

## Suggested shape

A one-sentence correction in the skill's "Surfaces" paragraph: the build refuses the condition, and at runtime the rule grants nothing. This is a `skills/**` change (Tier H, governed).

Suggested-grade: p2, domain:skills.
